item.description: I am a Ph.D. student in Economics at the Graduate School of Economics, Finance, and Management at Goethe University Frankfurt. My research interests lie in behavioral and experimental economics. Recent projects include studying how communication among first-movers in a trust game affects trust decisions, and how people use motivated reasoning to update their beliefs about trust.
